summary: Grace Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting receipt of a Complete Response Letter (CRL) from the FDA for its NDA for GTx-104 (intravenous nimodipine for aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage). The CRL cited deficiencies in CMC and non-clinical sections—leachables data, toxicology risk assessments, and manufacturing issues at contract manufacturer—but did not request additional clinical data. The company plans a Type A meeting and intends to resubmit. No deal, tender, buyback, activist, or structural change is involved; this is a routine regulatory update. The filing does not qualify as a special situation.
